Your photo and the AI

To identify a spider, the app resizes the photo you choose, removes camera details, and sends it once over an encrypted connection to our identification service, which passes it to an AI model provider. The provider is limited to zero-data-retention endpoints that do not store or train on it. Silkline does not keep the photo. Your finds and history stay on your phone.

What we do not collect

There are no accounts and no ads. We do not collect your name, email address, contacts, precise location or advertising ID.

Location

Location is optional and off unless you turn on Add location. The app asks for approximate location only, while it is open, and the phone turns it into a place name that is saved on your device with the find. Coordinates are not sent to us.

Service providers

The app uses these third-party services, which process data on our behalf under their own privacy terms:

  • RevenueCat — subscription and purchase status (privacy policy)
  • Cloudflare — hosting of our identification service (privacy policy)
  • OpenRouter and its AI model provider (Google) — identify the spider in your photo, on zero-data-retention endpoints only (privacy policy)

Purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google. We receive confirmation of your purchase status (through RevenueCat) but never your payment details.

AI features

When you use AI features, the content you submit is sent to our server and to our AI provider to produce a response. We do not use your content to train AI models. Do not submit information you do not want processed this way. You can report problematic AI output from within the app.

Children

Silkline is a general-audience nature tool and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has used the app, email us and we will help.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to object to certain processing. Contact rizwanrasheed046@gmail.com (or use the support page) and we will respond within 30 days.

Security and transfers

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Service providers may process data in countries other than yours.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where required, tell you in the app.
